News Flash
Early Voting Starts Tomorrow, October 17th - State Election
Town Clerk
Posted on October 16, 2026
Early voting for the
November 3, 2026 State Election
begins this Saturday, October 17!
Registered voters may cast their ballots in person during the early voting period, October 17–30, at the
Town Office Building, 381 Main Street
, in the main lobby.
Early Voting Hours
Saturday, October 17:
9:00 AM – 1:00 PM
Monday, October 19 – Thursday, October 22:
8:00 AM – 4:30 PM
Friday, October 23:
8:00 AM – 12:00 PM
Saturday, October 24:
9:00 AM – 1:00 PM
Monday, October 26 – Thursday, October 29:
8:00 AM – 4:30 PM
Friday, October 30:
8:00 AM – 12:00 PM
No appointment is necessary to vote early!
Voters may also cast their ballots on
Election Day, Tuesday, November 3, 2026
, from 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM at the Town Annex.
For questions or additional election information, please contact the Town Clerk's Office at
978-891-7318
or visit the Town's website at
https://ma-westnewbury.civicplus.com
.
